keySentence: The nanny helped them see kindness in small things.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The days became weeks. Ms. Clara pointed at small things. A bird making its nest. A neighbor waving with a smile. A cat sleeping in the sun. Emma began to point too. Ben drew the tiny moments. The nanny helped them see kindness in small things.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Over many quiet mornings, Ms. Clara taught the children how to notice the world. A bird's careful nesting in the apple tree. A neighbor's friendly wave from across the lane. Sunlight on the kitchen table, warming the breakfast plates. The way Mother tucked a flower behind her ear. Emma began pointing things out before Ms. Clara could even speak. Ben filled a small notebook with tiny drawings of every small kindness he saw — a sleeping kitten, a smiling baker, a child sharing bread. The nanny helped them see kindness in small things, and the world grew brighter. Their hearts had learned a new kind of seeing.
